question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Conspicuous
solution:
The correct answer is **"Obvious."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Conspicuous"** means something that is easily noticeable or obvious. (सुस्‍पष्‍ट, प्रकट, साफ़, प्रत्‍यक्ष)

 
 
• **Example**: *The bright red car was **conspicuous**__ in the parking lot.*
 
 
 
• **"Obvious"** is a synonym of **"conspicuous."**
 
• It means easily seen or understood. (जो आसानी से दिखाई दे या समझ में आए; स्‍पष्‍ट)
 __
 
• **Example**: *For **obvious**__ reasons, I’d prefer not to give my name.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 - Opaque** means something that is not transparent. (अपारदर्शी)
 
• **Option 2 - Unnoticeable** means something that is not easily seen or noticed. (कुछ ऐसा जो आसानी से देखा या ध्यान न दिया जाए)
 
• **Option 4 - Effective** means something that produces the desired result or has an intended effect. (अभीष्‍ट प्रभाव उत्‍पन्‍न करने वाला; प्रभावोत्‍पादक)
